adict-3-beta-existing-users.heading: Join the aDict App TestFlight Beta
adict-3-beta-existing-users.title: aDict App TestFlight Beta for iPhone, iPad, and Mac
adict-3-beta-existing-users.description: Join the aDict 3.0 TestFlight beta for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Try Youdao, local MDict and StarDict dictionaries, history, favorites, and more.
adict-3-beta-existing-users.lead: Install aDict 3.0 through TestFlight and try the rewritten dictionary app before its public App Store release.
